text:
[slide 1]
SAGA TELECOM BIGFLOW PLATFORM PERFORMANCE
High Performance Switching Hardware Platform
Platform Overview
BigFlow platform is a purpose-built Ethernet switching platform to address the growing demand for extreme low latency/jitter, comprehensive end-to-end tunnel network and high speed in the era of edge computing and AI.
BigFlow platform provides superb flexible I/O connectivity capability, support full-range port speeds from 10G to 100G.
Key Features of the BigFlow Platform
Ethernet capabilities: MAC table, Vxlan, IPFIX, ACL, EVC etc.
Full set of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocol
Rich OAM
Security feature set
Precision timing protocol
